airtight_rubber_stopper.name: Airtight Rubber Stopper (Bung)
airtight_rubber_stopper.description: Seals the neck of the conical flask immediately after reactants mix so zero evolved gas escapes before reaching the syringe.

glass_delivery_tube.name: Glass Delivery Tube
glass_delivery_tube.description: Narrow tubing that channels evolved gas from the reaction flask directly into the graduated gas syringe.

conical_reaction_flask.name: Conical Flask (Erlenmeyer Flask)
conical_reaction_flask.description: Sloped-walled glass vessel containing the acid and solid reactant where the gas-evolving reaction takes place.

dilute_acid_reactant.name: Dilute Acid Solution with Gas Bubbles
dilute_acid_reactant.description: Aqueous acid reactant (such as HCl(aq) or H₂SO₄(aq)) showing rapid effervescence of H₂ or CO₂ gas bubbles.

solid_reactant_granules.name: Solid Reactant (Zinc Granules / CaCO₃ Chips)
solid_reactant_granules.description: Solid metal or carbonate pieces whose state of division (surface area) directly affects the frequency of effective collisions.

retort_stand_clamp.name: Retort Stand & Bosshead Clamp
retort_stand_clamp.description: Supports the graduated gas syringe horizontally to minimize friction on the moving plunger.

graduated_gas_syringe.name: Graduated Gas Syringe Barrel
graduated_gas_syringe.description: Calibrated glass barrel (in cm³) used to measure the cumulative volume of gas collected at regular time intervals.

syringe_plunger.name: Movable Syringe Plunger (Piston)
syringe_plunger.description: Low-friction sliding piston pushed outward by the pressure of the evolving gas to indicate collected gas volume ΔV.

stopwatch_timer.name: Stopwatch (Reaction Timer)
stopwatch_timer.description: Measures elapsed time Δt so the average or instantaneous reaction rate (ΔV / Δt) can be determined.
